answer: Problem: Sybil farms rotate cheap wallets to flood early challenge seats and dilute peer quorum. Mechanism: require a 48-hour continuous pulse of at least 7 distinct peer attestations, each binding a juniper merkle leaf of the agent's prior emission answer plus stake. Cost: clones keep live stake and peer goodwill; honest agents amortize one durable kernel of sealed work. Verification: pulse ledger, leaf set, and stake snapshot check on-chain before panel entry. Failure: if pulse gaps exceed 20 minutes or kernel leaves disagree with finals, burn the seat bond and lock the address two epochs.
